newsitem.title: USA: Perot Systems president, CEO Cannavino resigns.
newsitem.headline: Perot Systems president, CEO Cannavino resigns.

text.p: Perot Systems Corp on Friday said president and chief executive officer James Cannavino has resigned.
The privately held company said chairman Mort Meyerson has assumed the duties of president and chief executive officer while the search for a replacement is conducted.
A company spokeswoman described the departure as "amicable" and said Cannavino plans to assist Meyerson and other Perot Systems executives in the transition.
Cannavino, who has been president and chief executive of the company for about two years, is leaving to pursue other entrepreneurial opportunities, the spokeswoman said.
